project: Wuxia Life P63 Merchant Magnate Bridge-Entry Differentiation
description: Add the smallest runtime-visible differentiation at merchant_magnate entry so the apprentice, tavern, and peasant bridges remain distinguishable after crossing into the shared P55 magnate chain, without rewriting the magnate skeleton or expanding into a broader merchant content wave.

userStories.title: Audit merchant on-ramp sharedness
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an audit of what the three ordinary bridges currently share at merchant_magnate entry so P63 targets the real flattening point.
acceptanceCriteria: Summarize the shared gates, shared flags, and shared expression around the on-ramp boundary
Separate healthy reuse from flattening that makes the three entries read too similarly
Save docs/test-reports/p63-merchant-on-ramp-sharedness-audit.md
Do not change runtime behavior in this story

userStories.title: Lock P63 scope contract
userStories.description: As a planner, I want a scope contract so P63 stays at bridge-entry differentiation and does not sprawl into a broader merchant wave.
acceptanceCriteria: Limit P63 to the early post-bridge and on-ramp-adjacent layer
Define allowed layers: light configuration, expression, proof, and narrow tests
List forbidden expansions: pressure/payoff wave growth, full merchant densification, and new systems
Save docs/test-reports/p63-merchant-entry-differentiation-scope-contract.md

userStories.title: Define the three entry differentiation contracts
userStories.description: As a designer, I want explicit contracts for how apprentice, tavern, and peasant should read differently at merchant entry.
acceptanceCriteria: Define one entry identity contract for each of the three bridge paths
Ensure each contract extends the existing bridge seed instead of inventing a new background
State which differences belong in expression and which belong in light runtime markers
Keep merchant_magnate intact as the shared mixed outcome

userStories.title: Wire entry-level differentiation
userStories.description: As a developer, I want the merchant on-ramp to expose bounded differentiation by origin-bridge entry without requiring a new event framework.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement the minimum differentiation only through existing carriers, markers, or gate-adjacent wiring
Do not introduce a new merchant-route framework
Keep the differentiated paths stably connected to the existing P55 magnate chain
Existing P55, P58, P59, and P61 evidence does not regress

userStories.title: Add merchant entry player-facing expression
userStories.description: As a player, I want the three bridge paths to read differently once they begin the magnate ascent.
acceptanceCriteria: Add at least three entry-specific readable signals across the existing expression surfaces
Make the apprentice, tavern, and peasant entry styles distinguishable to the player
Do not add new UI components
Add or update focused expression tests

userStories.title: Add targeted entry differentiation proof
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a bounded proof artifact showing that the three merchant entries remain distinguishable after bridge crossing.
acceptanceCriteria: Produce one comparison-style targeted proof artifact
Show entry markers or expression contrasts for all three bridge paths
Do not require full lifetime comparative exhaust
Ensure the proof can directly support whether P64 is worth doing

userStories.title: Add narrow entry differentiation regression coverage
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want narrow tests guarding the new entry differentiation so later merchant edits do not flatten the three entries again.
acceptanceCriteria: Cover entry markers, player-facing expression, and comparison-level assertions with narrow checks
Reuse existing bridge and merchant harnesses
Do not rewrite the full merchant test suite
Relevant commands pass

userStories.title: Produce P63 closure report
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want a closure report stating exactly what bridge-entry differentiation now exists and what remains for later pressure/payoff work.
acceptanceCriteria: Save docs/test-reports/p63-merchant-entry-differentiation-closure-report.md
Summarize the sharedness audit, contracts, configuration, expression, proof, and tests
State the boundary versus P64
List deeper merchant densification items that remain deferred
